description:
Enhance your truck's security and convenience with our premium hard Tri-Fold tonneau cover. Designed for effortless operation, it automatically latches into place when folded down—no manual locking required. Enjoy a sleek, durable design that protects your cargo while ensuring quick and easy access.
Features
Secure Fit with Added Convenience: This tonneau cover is engineered for a precise, secure fit and includes thoughtful upgrades. a complimentary LED light for improved nighttime visibility.
Superior Cargo Protection: Built with high-strength fiberglass (FRP) panels, this hard tri-fold tonneau cover offers exceptional protection against rain, snow, and road debris. It also resists impact and sharp objects, keeping your cargo safe and secure in all conditions.
Quick, No-Drill Installation: Designed for hassle-free setup, this FRP hard tri-fold tonneau cover installs easily with clear instructions and requires no drilling. Get it mounted quickly and ready to use. (Note: Cargo racks must be removed prior to installation.)
Heavy-Duty Durability You Can Trust: Reinforced fiberglass panels deliver long-lasting strength and impressive load-bearing capacity. A robust locking system keeps the cover firmly closed while driving, giving you confidence on every trip.
Safe & Reliable Operation: Install the cover according to the included instructions and ensure all bolts are fully tightened before driving. For safety, do not drive with the tonneau cover partially open.
1-year Warranty. For your safety, professional installation is Highly recommended
Fitment
Compatible with 2015-2026 Ford F150 F-150 with 5.5 ft bed only.
